title: ardisia procumbens
intro: Ardisia procumbens, commonly known as Red Clammy Berry or Red Stemmed Ardisia, is a plant species belonging to the family Myrsinaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Ardisia procumbens include its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions.
